name: Harker
title: getharker.com
shortDescription: Harker is a speech-to-text widget designed for desktop use, ideal for individuals who prefer talking over typing. It caters to users needing quick text entry across various applications, from emailing to chatting with AI. Example use case: A professional can use Harker to compose emails or messages by simply speaking, significantly speeding up their workflow and reducing the reliance on traditional typing.
